result.summary: The food delivery home screen renders mostly correctly, but one section header shows a raw, untranslated localization key instead of human-readable text. No other visual defects were found; partially clipped carousel items and the bottom-cut card are expected scrolling behavior.

issues.description: The section heading below 'Fastest near you' displays the raw i18n key 'home_feed.popular_title' instead of a localized title (e.g. 'Popular near you').
issues.suggestion: Add the missing translation string for 'home_feed.popular_title' to the active locale bundle and ensure a fallback (e.g. English) is shown when a key is missing rather than the raw key.
